newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia CPI in July down 0.5 percent from June.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia CPI in July down 0.5 percent from June.

text.p: Mongolia's consumer price index fell by 0.5 percent in July compared with June, central bank figures showed on Monday.
That compared with an increase of 3.7 in June compared with May, the Bank of Mongolia's Monthly Statistical Bulletin said.

The index showed a rise of 22.9 percent from the start of the year. The bulletin gave no annual figure for consumer price inflation, saying it was impossible to calculate because the basket used by the State Statistical Office had changed in January.
